newsitem.title: USA: Body Shop names CFO of U.S. unit.
newsitem.headline: Body Shop names CFO of U.S. unit.

text.p: Body Shop International Plc's U.S. unit, The Body Shop Inc, said Michael J. Florio has been named chief financial officer succeeding Paul Crawley who left the company at the end of February.

Florio is promoted to CFO after first serving as vice president of marketing operations and, more recently, vice president of retail marketing, where he was responsible for establishing strategies and guidelines for store operations including profitability studies, regional sales and marketing experimentation, and advertising test markets.
The company also said Priscilla Dawes has joined The Body Shop as vice president of promotions, a newly created position.

She will assume responsibility for creating promotions to maximize consumer appeal of The Body Shop's products in its 288 U.S. stores. She most recently served as Global Director of Marketing, Polo Franchise for Ralph Lauren Fragrances/Cosmair, Inc..
